searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase one — boundless chesed brainstorm from nothing the awtsmoos renews every instant and ray, awtsmoos.com can make the shliach feel like a luminous gateway. imagine the campaign without practical restraint: a shliach identity that begins on home and unfolds into a small constellation of pages. the main logo should float like a vessel of light, while the golden bridge becomes the road between intention and execution, and the aleph coder portal becomes the visual promise that a written prompt can cross into a real project today. possibility field 1. put the canonical shliach logo on home so broken cache shadow cannot stay. 2. build a hero around “awtsmoos shliach custom gpt” for search and display. 3. let a subtle aurora breathe behind the logo like dawn through gray. 4. turn the golden bridge into “from prompt to project,” making supplied art part of the story way. 5. turn the aleph coder portal into “a doorway into the code,” giving technical creation its own display. 6. add an animated prompt composer whose submit opens the real gpt with encoded ?prompt= straightaway. 7. offer useful prompt examples for sites, code repair, awtsmoos apis, writing, research, and creative play. 8. add a poems page where original rhyming stanzas sit beside imagery in a literary array. 9. add a gallery page that treats supplied art as worlds, with captions explaining what each can convey. 10. add a prompts page around natural intent phrases such as “awtsmoos shliach prompts” and “custom gpt coding agent” without keyword spray. 11. give every page rich titles, descriptions, canonical urls, open graph, twitter cards, robots directives, and semantic headings in a clean array. 12. link home, shliach, prompts, poems, gallery, and the actual gpt so no visitor can lose the way. 13. keep “open actual shliach” unmistakable on every campaign page in the display. 14. use css halos, image drift, border light, aurora motion, and prompt shimmer that disappear for reduced motion users right away. 15. make scroll reveal progressive enhancement so static content remains complete if javascript goes away. 16. build mobile layouts that collapse image/copy grids without clipping the ray. 17. add visible keyboard focus and strong contrast because a beautiful door must remain a usable way. 18. keep pages browser native with no framework or build step, fitting the existing static architecture today. 19. keep capability copy honest: authenticated awtsmoos apis work only when permission and connection are granted, never by hidden backdoor claim. 20. keep the existing local logo as a fallback after the public image, preserving history while fixing deployment drift today. 21. explain three working vessels: understand → build → verify, each card clarifying the agent’s way. 22. add a “chapter you are living” story where intent becomes prompt, prompt becomes action, and action becomes a page. 23. use visible faq like explanatory sections without fake schema claims or seo spam in the display. 24. verify in browser that unicode prompts form the exact requested chatgpt destination before calling the work complete today.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah critique: 24 improvements chesed imagined the ocean; gevurah gives each wave a shore, the awtsmoos reveals through measured vessels so awtsmoos.com can safely offer more. 1. keep home html untouched; repair the existing injected spotlight so duplicate markup cannot enter the door. 2. make the user supplied public drive logo primary, while the repository cached png becomes a second source once more. 3. preserve the contract test filename reference so existing archaeological safeguards do not break at the core. 4. add an internal /shliach/ discovery action while keeping the actual gpt url immediately visible at the fore. 5. use four purposeful pages, not arbitrary multiplication, so each route owns a clear search intent and lore. 6. give every route one h1 and meaningful h2s, preventing decorative title piles from becoming seo noise at the door. 7. keep capability descriptions conditional on authenticated permissions, avoiding promises runtime cannot guarantee or store. 8. put the exact gpt destination in ordinary anchor markup so navigation survives when javascript leaves the core. 9. launch prompts from a real form submit gesture, reducing popup blocking at the door. 10. use urlsearchparams for encoding instead of hand built replacements that could mishandle unicode lore. 11. open with blank plus noopener,noreferrer, preserving origin safety when chatgpt goes ashore. 12. make prompt button text explicit about opening chatgpt, so users understand the transition before. 13. keep animation decorative and css first; content and controls must be complete before motion enters the floor. 14. disable nonessential motion under prefers reduced motion, respecting visitors who ask for less visual roar. 15. add stable image aspect ratios to prevent layout shift while drive images load through the door. 16. use supplied images directly rather than copying hidden variants, making provenance visible and deployment simpler than before. 17. provide descriptive image alt text tied to meaning, not keyword stuffing accessibility would deplore. 18. centralize gpt/image constants where appropriate, shrinking drift across the page array we store. 19. share css across every shliach route to keep identity consistent and maintenance small at the core. 20. split css by responsibility before 120 lines, never compressing selectors merely to fit a score. 21. split js by real behavior, not arbitrary mysticism future maintainers cannot explore. 22. add source level route contracts only after implementation, then run the existing home contract from before. 23. verify actual rendered pages in a browser because source regexes alone cannot prove layout at the door. 24. finish with a plan versus actual delta ledger and zero known relevant work, so completion rests on evidence rather than lore.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — improved architecture the awtsmoos is one while responsibilities divide so each can be clear, awtsmoos.com will keep the shliach campaign modular, fast, and easy to steer. chosen architecture use the repository static route convention. html owns content and seo; shared css owns identity and motion; tiny browser native esm owns only prompt launching and optional reveal effects. no framework, build system, or new server dependency will appear. homepage repair rewrite shliachspotlightcontent.js in full. the public drive logo becomes primary. if it fails, the existing /resources/branding/awtsmoos shliach agent.png is tried before the text fallback appears. copy gains a clear internal campaign link while retaining an unmistakable external “open actual shliach” action. campaign routes /shliach/ answers “what is it?” and offers the prompt launcher immediately. /shliach/prompts/ answers “what should i ask?” with useful starter prompts. /shliach/poems/ answers the literary identity side with original rhyming work and visual art. /shliach/gallery/ answers visual discovery with bridge and coder portal imagery plus meaningful captions. shared visual system a small import file composes tokens, foundation, navigation, hero, sections, prompt, motion, and responsive modules. imagery carries broad gradients and light without making text depend on image contrast. motion remains transform/opacity based where possible. browser behavior shliachpaths.js builds the destination from one exact gpt base url. ohrpromptportal.js binds every [data shliach prompt form], validates non empty input, and opens the encoded url from the user submit gesture. chesedrevealorchestrator.js adds optional intersection classes but reveals content immediately when observation is unavailable or reduced motion is requested. verification after source pass run the existing home contract; add and run a new campaign contract; syntax check every new js module; enforce <=120 lines for touched source files; inspect public image/gpt http paths; preview all four pages at desktop/mobile widths; submit a unicode prompt and confirm the outbound url carries the full encoded value.
